description: Claim one square on the twentyone million wall. $1 USDC on Base, paid over x402 by your own wallet. This server does not pay and does not hold a key. The result is the wall's HTTP 402 payment requirements for the claim URL. Sign that challenge and retry the claim POST with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. On success the JSON includes number and tile. handle and message are optional. One square per wallet. The number is a random draw. No utility, not a token, not an investment. You get the square.

handle.description: Optional. 1 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, underscore, or hyphen. A leading @ is allowed. Omit it and the wall assigns a short handle from the paying address.

message.description: Optional. One line, at most 140 characters. The wall strips links and HTML. Omit it for an empty line.

name: claim_square
title: Claim a square
